trailhead.label: Cates, Lanzo Torinese, the board’s start

cautions: The path can be very wet and slippery after heavy rain, as the board warns.
Short stretches on hamlet lanes and two crossings of the provincial roads: keep your dog on a short lead there.
A short cobbled stretch and steps near the Mulino Turcin.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
